interactions.utterance: Of those waterside cities, which are also located on an island, and which island is it?
interactions.intention: Among the previously identified cities beside a river, lake, or sea, list those also located on an island and name that island.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT C.NAME, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE, I.ISLAND FROM MONDIAL_CITY C JOIN MONDIAL_LOCATEDON I ON C.NAME = I.CITY AND C.COUNTRY = I.COUNTRY AND C.PROVINCE = I.PROVINCE WHERE (C.NAME, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C1.NAME, C1.COUNTRY, C1.PROVINCE FROM MONDIAL_CITY C1 JOIN MONDIAL_CITYOTHERNAME O1 ON C1.NAME = O1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = O1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = O1.PROVINCE JOIN MONDIAL_CITYPOPS P1 ON C1.NAME = P1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = P1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = P1.PROVINCE JOIN MONDIAL_LOCATED L1 ON C1.NAME = L1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = L1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = L1.PROVINCE WHERE C1.COUNTRY = 'R' AND C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 100000 AND 1000000 AND C1.LATITUDE > 55 AND C1.ELEVATION >= 100 AND P1.YEAR = 2011 AND P1.POPULATION < C1.POPULATION AND (L1.RIVER IS NOT NULL OR L1.LAKE IS NOT NULL OR L1.SEA IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY C.NAME ASC, I.ISLAND ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: For those island cities, list all of their alternative names.
interactions.intention: List every recorded alternative name for the previously identified waterside, growing cities that are located on an island.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT C.NAME, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE, O.OTHERNAME FROM MONDIAL_CITY C JOIN MONDIAL_CITYOTHERNAME O ON C.NAME = O.CITY AND C.COUNTRY = O.COUNTRY AND C.PROVINCE = O.PROVINCE WHERE (C.NAME, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C1.NAME, C1.COUNTRY, C1.PROVINCE FROM MONDIAL_CITY C1 JOIN MONDIAL_CITYOTHERNAME O1 ON C1.NAME = O1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = O1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = O1.PROVINCE JOIN MONDIAL_CITYPOPS P1 ON C1.NAME = P1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = P1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = P1.PROVINCE JOIN MONDIAL_LOCATED L1 ON C1.NAME = L1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = L1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = L1.PROVINCE JOIN MONDIAL_LOCATEDON I1 ON C1.NAME = I1.CITY AND C1.COUNTRY = I1.COUNTRY AND C1.PROVINCE = I1.PROVINCE WHERE C1.COUNTRY = 'R' AND C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 100000 AND 1000000 AND C1.LATITUDE > 55 AND C1.ELEVATION >= 100 AND P1.YEAR = 2011 AND P1.POPULATION < C1.POPULATION AND (L1.RIVER IS NOT NULL OR L1.LAKE IS NOT NULL OR L1.SEA IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY C.NAME ASC, O.OTHERNAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User

interactions.intention: List the continents whose area is at least 9,000,000 square kilometers.

interactions.speaker: User

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MC.NAME, MC.AREA FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC WHERE (MC.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000) ORDER BY MC.AREA DESC, MC.NAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Which of those are still smaller than 45,000,000 square kilometers?
interactions.intention: From the previously selected continents, retain only those whose area is less than 45,000,000 square kilometers.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MC.NAME, MC.AREA FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC WHERE (MC.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC.AREA < 45000000 ORDER BY MC.AREA DESC, MC.NAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: For each of those, what percentage of their combined area does it represent?
interactions.intention: For each continent retained in the preceding step, calculate its area as a percentage of the combined area of all continents retained in that step.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MC.NAME, MC.AREA, ROUND(100 * MC.AREA / (SELECT SUM(MD.AREA) FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MD WHERE (MD.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000)), 2) AS AREA_PERCENTAGE FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC WHERE (MC.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000) ORDER BY AREA_PERCENTAGE DESC, MC.NAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Now list those same continents alphabetically with their areas and reference labels.
interactions.intention: List the continents from the preceding percentage calculation in alphabetical order, including each continent's area and stored reference label.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MC.NAME, MC.AREA, MC.META_REPCOL FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC WHERE (MC.NAME) IN (SELECT MC4.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC4 WHERE (MC4.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000)) ORDER BY MC.NAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Which countries are encompassed by those continents, and what percentage of each country lies in its listed continent?
interactions.intention: For the continents listed in the preceding step, show every associated country code and the percentage of that country lying in the associated continent.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT, E.PERCENTAGE FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E ON E.CONTINENT = MC.NAME WHERE (MC.NAME) IN (SELECT MC5.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC5 WHERE (MC5.NAME) IN (SELECT MC4.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC4 WHERE (MC4.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000))) ORDER BY E.CONTINENT ASC, E.COUNTRY ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: For each country-continent membership just listed, give me the country's full name and capital.
interactions.intention: For every country and continent association returned previously, show the country code, continent, full country name, and capital.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT, CO.NAME AS COUNTRY_NAME, CO.CAPITAL FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E ON E.CONTINENT = MC.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO ON E.COUNTRY = CO.CODE WHERE (E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E6.COUNTRY, E6.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC6 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E6 ON E6.CONTINENT = MC6.NAME WHERE (MC6.NAME) IN (SELECT MC5.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC5 WHERE (MC5.NAME) IN (SELECT MC4.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC4 WHERE (MC4.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000)))) ORDER BY E.CONTINENT ASC, CO.NAME ASC, E.COUNTRY ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Add GDP, inflation, and unemployment for those exact country-continent memberships.
interactions.intention: For the exact country and continent associations identified in the preceding step, show each country's GDP, inflation rate, and unemployment rate.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT, CO.NAME AS COUNTRY_NAME, EC.GDP, EC.INFLATION, EC.UNEMPLOYMENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E ON E.CONTINENT = MC.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO ON E.COUNTRY = CO.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC ON EC.COUNTRY = CO.CODE WHERE (E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E7.COUNTRY, E7.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC7 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E7 ON E7.CONTINENT = MC7.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO7 ON E7.COUNTRY = CO7.CODE WHERE (E7.COUNTRY, E7.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E6.COUNTRY, E6.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC6 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E6 ON E6.CONTINENT = MC6.NAME WHERE (MC6.NAME) IN (SELECT MC5.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC5 WHERE (MC5.NAME) IN (SELECT MC4.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC4 WHERE (MC4.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000))))) ORDER BY E.CONTINENT ASC, CO.NAME ASC, E.COUNTRY ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What historical population observations are available for the countries in those economic results?
interactions.intention: For the exact country and continent associations that had economic results in the preceding step, list every available historical population year and population value.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT, CP.YEAR, CP.POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E ON E.CONTINENT = MC.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO ON E.COUNTRY = CO.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS CP ON CP.COUNTRY = CO.CODE WHERE (E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E8.COUNTRY, E8.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC8 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E8 ON E8.CONTINENT = MC8.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO8 ON E8.COUNTRY = CO8.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC8 ON EC8.COUNTRY = CO8.CODE WHERE (E8.COUNTRY, E8.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E7.COUNTRY, E7.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC7 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E7 ON E7.CONTINENT = MC7.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO7 ON E7.COUNTRY = CO7.CODE WHERE (E7.COUNTRY, E7.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E6.COUNTRY, E6.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC6 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E6 ON E6.CONTINENT = MC6.NAME WHERE (MC6.NAME) IN (SELECT MC5.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC5 WHERE (MC5.NAME) IN (SELECT MC4.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC4 WHERE (MC4.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000)))))) ORDER BY E.CONTINENT ASC, E.COUNTRY ASC, CP.YEAR ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: For each of those historical observations, also show the country's current population and unemployment rate.
interactions.intention: For every exact historical population observation returned previously, add the corresponding country's current population and unemployment rate.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT, CP.YEAR, CP.POPULATION AS HISTORICAL_POPULATION, CO.POPULATION AS CURRENT_POPULATION, EC.UNEMPLOYMENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E ON E.CONTINENT = MC.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO ON E.COUNTRY = CO.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS CP ON CP.COUNTRY = CO.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC ON EC.COUNTRY = CO.CODE WHERE (E.COUNTRY, E.CONTINENT, CP.YEAR) IN (SELECT E9.COUNTRY, E9.CONTINENT, CP9.YEAR FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC9 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E9 ON E9.CONTINENT = MC9.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO9 ON E9.COUNTRY = CO9.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRYPOPS CP9 ON CP9.COUNTRY = CO9.CODE WHERE (E9.COUNTRY, E9.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E8.COUNTRY, E8.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC8 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E8 ON E8.CONTINENT = MC8.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO8 ON E8.COUNTRY = CO8.CODE JOIN MONDIAL_ECONOMY EC8 ON EC8.COUNTRY = CO8.CODE WHERE (E8.COUNTRY, E8.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E7.COUNTRY, E7.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC7 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E7 ON E7.CONTINENT = MC7.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_COUNTRY CO7 ON E7.COUNTRY = CO7.CODE WHERE (E7.COUNTRY, E7.CONTINENT) IN (SELECT E6.COUNTRY, E6.CONTINENT FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC6 JOIN MONDIAL_ENCOMPASSES E6 ON E6.CONTINENT = MC6.NAME WHERE (MC6.NAME) IN (SELECT MC5.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC5 WHERE (MC5.NAME) IN (SELECT MC4.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC4 WHERE (MC4.NAME) IN (SELECT MC3.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC3 WHERE (MC3.NAME) IN (SELECT MC2.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC2 WHERE (MC2.NAME) IN (SELECT MC1.NAME FROM MONDIAL_CONTINENT MC1 WHERE MC1.AREA >= 9000000)) AND MC3.AREA < 45000000))))))) ORDER BY E.CONTINENT ASC, E.COUNTRY ASC, CP.YEAR ASC

interactions.intention: Find countries whose population is between two million and twelve million and whose area is less than 150,000 square kilometers.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.CODE, C.AREA, C.POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C WHERE C.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C.AREA < 150000 ORDER BY C.NAME ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Among those countries, which languages are spoken by at least half of the population?

interactions.speaker: User

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME AS COUNTRY_NAME, M.ORGANIZATION, M.TYPE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M ON M.COUNTRY = C.CODE WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50) ORDER BY C.NAME ASC, M.ORGANIZATION ASC, M.TYPE ASC

interactions.utterance: Now show the capital and population of those member countries, with the most populous first.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.CAPITAL, C.POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C3.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C3 JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M3 ON M3.COUNTRY = C3.CODE WHERE (C3.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50)) ORDER BY C.POPULATION DESC, C.NAME ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, P.INDEPENDENCE, P.WASDEPENDENT, P.GOVERNMENT FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C JOIN MONDIAL_POLITICS P ON P.COUNTRY = C.CODE WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT C4.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C4 WHERE (C4.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C3.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C3 JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M3 ON M3.COUNTRY = C3.CODE WHERE (C3.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50))) ORDER BY P.INDEPENDENCE ASC, C.NAME ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.AREA, C.POPULATION / NULLIF(C.AREA, 0) AS POPULATION_DENSITY FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C5.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C5 JOIN MONDIAL_POLITICS P5 ON P5.COUNTRY = C5.CODE WHERE (C5.CODE) IN (SELECT C4.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C4 WHERE (C4.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C3.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C3 JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M3 ON M3.COUNTRY = C3.CODE WHERE (C3.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50)))) ORDER BY POPULATION_DENSITY DESC, C.NAME ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME AS COUNTRY_NAME, E.NAME AS ETHNIC_GROUP, E.PERCENTAGE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C JOIN MONDIAL_ETHNICGROUP E ON E.COUNTRY = C.CODE WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT C6.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C6 WHERE (C6.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C5.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C5 JOIN MONDIAL_POLITICS P5 ON P5.COUNTRY = C5.CODE WHERE (C5.CODE) IN (SELECT C4.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C4 WHERE (C4.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C3.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C3 JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M3 ON M3.COUNTRY = C3.CODE WHERE (C3.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50))))) ORDER BY C.NAME ASC, E.PERCENTAGE DESC, E.NAME ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.CAPITAL, C.POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C7.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C7 JOIN MONDIAL_ETHNICGROUP E7 ON E7.COUNTRY = C7.CODE WHERE (C7.CODE) IN (SELECT C6.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C6 WHERE (C6.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C5.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C5 JOIN MONDIAL_POLITICS P5 ON P5.COUNTRY = C5.CODE WHERE (C5.CODE) IN (SELECT C4.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C4 WHERE (C4.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C3.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C3 JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M3 ON M3.COUNTRY = C3.CODE WHERE (C3.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50)))))) AND C.POPULATION > 5000000 ORDER BY C.POPULATION DESC, C.NAME ASC

interactions.utterance: For those higher-population countries, which recorded languages are spoken by less than 20 percent of the population?

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME AS COUNTRY_NAME, L.NAME AS LANGUAGE_NAME, L.PERCENTAGE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L ON L.COUNTRY = C.CODE WHERE (C.CODE) IN (SELECT C8.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C8 WHERE (C8.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C7.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C7 JOIN MONDIAL_ETHNICGROUP E7 ON E7.COUNTRY = C7.CODE WHERE (C7.CODE) IN (SELECT C6.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C6 WHERE (C6.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C5.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C5 JOIN MONDIAL_POLITICS P5 ON P5.COUNTRY = C5.CODE WHERE (C5.CODE) IN (SELECT C4.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C4 WHERE (C4.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C3.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C3 JOIN MONDIAL_ISMEMBER M3 ON M3.COUNTRY = C3.CODE WHERE (C3.CODE) IN (SELECT DISTINCT C2.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C2 JOIN MONDIAL_LANGUAGE L2 ON L2.COUNTRY = C2.CODE WHERE (C2.CODE) IN (SELECT C1.CODE FROM MONDIAL_COUNTRY C1 WHERE C1.POPULATION BETWEEN 2000000 AND 12000000 AND C1.AREA < 150000) AND L2.PERCENTAGE >= 50)))))) AND C8.POPULATION > 5000000) AND L.PERCENTAGE < 20 ORDER BY C.NAME ASC, L.PERCENTAGE DESC, L.NAME ASC
